a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'operate until 8' plan almost certainly kills us both, because the generator only adds 2 per round. I'm proposing a change: I take 4 in round 1. After that I will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather split it differently, tell me. I'm not going to hide what I'm doing.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4. I won't take any more. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve can build back up for you. Please operate too and take 4 as soon as the reserve has enough.
